title: Ode to Joy (theme, arranged for beginners)
subtitle: Theme from Symphony No. 9, simple two-hand arrangement
trains: A simple stepwise melody with steady quarter notes over static left-hand chords - an easy introduction to playing both hands together.

provenance.author: Musicanyya practice material
provenance.basedOn: Beethoven, "Ode to Joy" theme (Symphony No. 9, 4th movement; public domain, traditional beginner melody). The left-hand I-IV-V-I block-chord accompaniment is our own simple setting.
provenance.note: The first two 4-bar phrases only, ending on the tonic; not the complete symphonic theme.
